description: This PHP source file defines a custom Request class extending Symfony's HttpFoundation Request. It customizes request parameter retrieval with deprecated method warning and handles authorization headers from globals. The class is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the framework's HTTP handling namespace.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A custom request class extending Symfony's Request to include deprecated get method with backtrace check and a static method to create a request object from server globals, handling authorization headers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Overrides the parent get method to warn about deprecated usage in certain backtrace contexts.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Request class from PHP globals, ensuring authorization headers are correctly populated from server variables.
